title: Lisbon, the street
logline: The street outside the invented Lisbon room, through opened shutters: a hill, tiles, a yellow tram from the postcard drawn passing below, laundry. The one thing on the page he had a picture of is the tram.

panels.composition: A view down through opened wooden shutters onto a steep tiled street with a yellow tram passing below and laundry strung between buildings, bright light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a view down through opened wooden shutters onto a steep street of tiled buildings with a yellow tram passing below and laundry strung between balconies, bright light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The tram from the postcard; the rest invented.
